verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an official MCP server that lets Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, and other MCP-compatible clients query logs, author prompts/scorers, configure monitoring, and run evals — a clear server-side MCP offering that agents can connect to. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation that the MCP server works as documented (only first-party docs and a probe confirm its existence).
